_comment: ONE fixture for the tyre position service. layouts, tokens, pinned and compare are written by hand. matrix is GENERATED from the JS (UPDATE_POSITION_FIXTURE=1 npx vitest run src/test/tyrePositionMirror.test.js) and is what pins the SQL mirror to the JS, case for case. Row shape: [layout id, token, kind, status, reason, canonical, slot]. A layout may carry `mappings` (verified per-layout ERP spellings). Synthetic data only.
